lots.key_photo_findings: Brush signature on the lower body reads 錦光山造 (Kinkozan zo, made by Kinkozan) in black, painted within the decoration rather than on the base. Decoration: geese in flight and resting among reeds, cream ground with grey cloud wash, enamelled floral neck band and hexagon-diaper floral foot band. Little or no gilding visible, which points to later Meiji/Taisho export ware rather than top Kinkozan work. No obvious cracks or chips in the photos; bases and interiors not shown.
lots.condition: Appears sound in photos with some surface wear; bases, rims from above and interiors not shown, so hairlines and restoration cannot be ruled out.
lots.question_for_armitage: What is the height of each vase? Are there any chips, hairline cracks or restoration (please check rims and feet), and is there any mark on the bases as well as the side signature?
